title: Krea 2 Turbo (public line)
description: 8-step distilled Krea 2 Turbo text-to-image worker: one prompt in, one 1K PNG out. The schedule is pinned at 8 steps / CFG 0, and the age rule runs before any GPU work. Weights come from Comfy-Org's ungated Krea 2 repack, so a fresh worker fetches them with no Hugging Face token.

input.name: Checkpoint
input.description: Either a Hugging Face repo id with a filename (org/name::path/file.safetensors, downloaded and cached on first load) or a path to a .safetensors file already on the worker. The default is Comfy-Org's ungated repack: a fresh worker has no Hugging Face credentials, and krea/Krea-2-Turbo is licence-gated (401), so it would need HF_TOKEN and an accepted licence.

input.name: Hugging Face cache
input.description: Where the checkpoint, the Qwen3-VL encoder and the Qwen-Image VAE are cached after the first download. Point it at a network volume to avoid paying for them on every cold worker.
